notes.title: 🎌We went to BitSummit the 13th: Summer of Yokai!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289245/9513c75dd1f3f62b5b10deb5e7caa5c7344ac6c8.png"][/img]Hello everyone![/p][p]Last weekend, we had the joy of showcasing [b]ONE MORE PLATE![/b] at [b]BitSummit[/b] in Kyoto — Japan’s biggest indie game festival! 🍱✨[/p][p][/p][p]This time, we presented our [i]Japan-themed world[/i], full of hungry yokai, weird plates and food! The demo booth was packed and we were blown away by the laughter, screams and chaos from all of you who stopped by - it was so much fun seeing real players enjoy the game in person! [/p][p][/p][p]We’re bringing all this love and energy back into development, and we can’t wait to serve you more chaos soon. Stay tuned!🍽️[/p][p][/p][p]With love,
Team Okawari 👩‍🍳[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ydqOFRUepwg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289245/73333f6c304560eec30551857bb285aa295f4d86.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289245/7053958d2efcf3d8c47532ad8497cce1930b4ad7.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289245/d0713d61d905eb4a5b1094eaf3d7f4b75db6b0d2.jpg"][/img][/p]
